charts.question: Geometry materializations over all versions
charts.supported_finding: Counts use the same highway scope and oracle per version.
charts.interpretation_boundary: This is a reproducible experiment on a single regional OSM extract and a local SQLite store. Work counts measure recomputation. System latency and production availability require separate measurement.
